k.sel: Wikidata items of class motorcycle model (Q23866334) and motorcycle model series (Q71310524) or motorcycle (Q34493) with an English Wikipedia article, read in full through the query service (1,194 + 225 rows), joined with the model rows of Wikipedia's per-manufacturer lists (List of Honda, Yamaha, Suzuki, Kawasaki, Harley-Davidson, Royal Enfield, Triumph, Moto Guzzi, Norton, BSA, AMC, Ariel, Douglas, Greeves, James, Peugeot, Velocette, Vincent, Laverda, Benelli and Bimota motorcycles) and the Bajaj, KTM, Hero MotoCorp and TVS company/category pages. Sections are marques; scooters, mopeds and cubs are in the next kind. Concepts, prototypes, quads and side-by-sides are left out. Marques and countries follow Wikipedia's List of motorcycle manufacturers (read to its end). Covers 2955 model lines under 100 marques of about 430 marque names on that page; the Honda list (engine-size table of about 350 rows) was joined only in part, the BMW, Ducati, Aprilia, Husqvarna and Indian model lists have no Wikipedia list and rest on Wikidata and the category pages, and Vespa and Lambretta generation lists were read but kept as versions of the existing entries.
